list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A tetranuclear Tb cluster with a sulfide bridge between terbium centers and triimidosulfite ligand units; the reported structure shows half a complex molecule in the asymmetric unit and lattice solvent.

synthesis.procedure: For complexes 3–6, precursor 1 (100 mg, 0.13 mmol, 1 equiv.) and TbCl3 (34 mg, 0.13 mmol, 1 equiv.) were transferred into a Schlenk flask and stirred in THF at room temperature for 24 h. The solids were removed by filtration, and the terbium species were crystallized from a saturated THF solution at 238 K. Complexes 3–6 were obtained as an inseparable mixture; crystallization solvent mixtures changed their proportions, but the bulk could not be purified.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; 238 K for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solids removed by filtration; crystallized from saturated THF solution. The terbium products could not be separated from each other.

title: Sulfur-nitrogen bond activation to give polynuclear terbium(III) complexes
